note: Slot plan for the playable proof route (T08-T15). It lists the ordinary events each week plays and nothing else. Week 1 carries the proof setup event and one routine beat so the loop can be played from the first tap. The authored fallback event is never planned: it only substitutes for a planned event that cannot be presented. Weeks 2-12 carry two placeholder routine beats each (the minimum decisions a week needs), so the route can be walked to the callbacks: a required callback that is due takes one of its week's slots and displaces the last planned beat (T15). The T18 walk-through places the setup in week 3; here it is week 1, and the callback windows (7-8, 10-11) are unchanged. Real campaign content replaces the beats from T21.
